original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 CoinDesk reports stablecoin wallets are actively challenging traditional bank accounts as the primary consumer money hub. When everyday payment flows settle natively on-chain, the traditional friction between fiat banking and crypto markets dissolves. Dollar liquidity sitting inside self-custody wallets provides an immediate runway into major assets like $BTC. Yet on the 1H chart, Bitcoin remains locked in tight compression near $78,538, waiting for this macro liquidity shift to show up in spot order books. Bullish, bearish, or wait Is the market confirming this catalyst, or fading it?
